reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model PA-10, a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
The date code 2126 on the label is within the recalled range 2126 to 2319.
The serial number is not a separate rule for this program, so no serial check applies.
Amazon.com is a listed retailer and the purchase date 2022-08-25 falls inside the sale window; no receipt is required for this claim type.
No destruction photo is required for this remedy (replacement), so none is needed.
No other claim shares a photo, address, email, serial number, or payout account with this one.
All eligibility checks pass and the remedy requested is repair or replacement with no refund, so the claim is approved.
